about: Draft, for the gallery to check. Nothing here is written to the store. Where each artist is described elsewhere, found by searching Wikidata on 2026-09-28 for each of the 171 artist entries. "confirmed": the years of birth and death in our entry agree with Wikidata's. "likely": one Canadian artist of that name, and no year of ours to check against. "possible": a name that matches and nothing else. Only the addresses are meant for use: Wikidata's dates are shown for checking and are not always right.
